title: Billy Berg's and the small Los Angeles clubs
summary: Billy Berg's was the best small club, with Teddy Bunn, Leo Watson, Slim Gaillard, Nellie Lutcher and Harry the Hipster Gibson.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And how about small clubs. Were there small clubs around town?

We had little clubs that didn't mean a thing, like Billy Berg's. That was the best one of all. And all the rest of them, they couldn't make it. But Billy Berg, that was the most popular one. Like they had Teddy Bunn and that bunch. You remember Teddy Bunn? Leo Watson?
Leo Watson I remember (inaudible) Slim Gaillard, from his days with
Well, he was with that group, with Teddy Bunn.
And then Nellie Lutcher started there too. Then they had Harry the Hipster Gibson. Remember him?
Yeah, he's somewhere I don't know. And that's where Slim Gaillard and -- Slim and Slam, they started there.
Yeah. Oh, there were a lot. That was the only hot spot, I mean, outside the biggies, the two biggies.
